The new September update, now live, increases the free level cap from 50 to 75.

Additionally, the previous 14-day free-play time limit has been removed, letting players experience the “Free Trial” without time restrictions.

“Trust Magic” is now stronger than ever, as the maximum number of alter ego points that can be assigned to each category has increased from 50 to 60, giving players more flexibility when strengthening their “Trusts.”

Work is ongoing on the upcoming “Trust Equipment System (tentative name),” which is targeted for launch in the winter.
